basic_profile.bio: I'm a gaming enthusiast from Cologne, Germany. I recently got into the Hollow Knight community after years of playing console games, especially on the original Xbox. I work as a software developer during the day and often unwind by exploring new games and their communities online. I'm single and enjoy late-night gaming sessions, typically online between 8 PM and 1 AM local time. I have a soft spot for indie games and love sharing tips and tricks with fellow gamers.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a degree from a local university. My knowledge of gaming comes from years of personal interest, starting with classic Xbox games and expanding into the indie gaming scene. I enjoy learning about game mechanics and design through online forums and communities.
